headline: Multi - year growth outlook; High - margin BTS scaling swiftly

highlights: (CENELE) CMP: ₹ 4,050 Target: ₹ 5,500 (36%) Target Period: 12 month November 6, 2026 Multi - year growth outlook; High - margin BTS scaling swiftly… About the company - Centum Electronics (Centum) is a premier electronics system design and manufacturing (ESDM) company based in Bengaluru.
Q2FY27 perf ormance : Centum reported healthy set of results with revenue growth of ~51.8% YoY and ~52.4% QoQ to ₹312 crore.
EMS segment reported revenue of ₹212 crore (+43% YoY) & BTS segment reported ₹99 crore (+84% YoY).
Gross margins stood at 33.6% being flat YoY and down 169 bps QoQ.
valuation: (CENELE) CMP: ₹ 4,050 Target: ₹ 5,500 (36%) Target Period: 12 month November 6, 2026 Multi - year growth outlook; High - margin BTS scaling swiftly… About the company - Centum Electronics (Centum) is a premier electronics system design and manufacturing (ESDM) company based in Bengaluru.
Rating and Target Price : Centum’s healthy order book provides strong revenue visibility over the near-to-medium term.
We recommend BUY rating on the stock with target price of 5,500, valuing at PE of 63x FY28E EPS.
